_nota: Capa inglesa de la sala de Ineditos. Trae solo lo traducible: el aparato (presentacion, sinopsis, Con voz y voto, lineas de tarjeta y metadatos) y los textos de interfaz. Los titulos de las novelas y de los fragmentos, y los fragmentos mismos, se quedan en español y salen marcados con lang=es.
seo_titulo: Unpublished novels by Antonio López Sánchez
seo_desc: Four unpublished novels by the Cuban writer Antonio López Sánchez: synopses, excerpts in Spanish and the author's notes. Rights available outside Cuba.
aviso_adultos: A novel with sexually explicit passages, written for adult readers.

preguntas.significado: Questions. A Day in the Life of Juan Pérez
preguntas.linea: A single day can fit in a novel. Even if, at times, the questions overflow.
preguntas.seo_titulo: Preguntas, an unpublished novel | Antonio López Sánchez
preguntas.seo_desc: One day in the life of Juan Pérez, a journalist in the capital of an Antillean island. Synopsis, prelude and first chapter of an unpublished Cuban novel.

mis-diarios-de-cama.linea: A woman's diary, with her duties, her loves, her sorrows. A novel told in the first person by its own protagonist.
mis-diarios-de-cama.seo_titulo: Mis diarios de cama, an unpublished novel | Antonio López Sánchez
mis-diarios-de-cama.seo_desc: Ana Paula records the hardest years of her life in her bedside diaries. Synopsis and two entries of an unpublished Cuban novel, for adult readers.

sonidos.linea: The search for the perfect sound breeds a murderer in the nineteenth century, and unleashes a story of horrors and deaths that will echo into the present, and perhaps the future.
sonidos.seo_titulo: Sonidos, an unpublished horror novel | Antonio López Sánchez
sonidos.seo_desc: A nineteenth-century English nobleman seeks the perfect sound in death and pain. Synopsis and three excerpts of an unpublished Cuban horror novel.

palabras.linea: A pursuit across several dimensions leads to the Library. Past and present will cross their lines. Ambition will crave power. Minutes may be centuries, but love will remain untouched.
palabras.seo_titulo: Palabras, an unpublished fantasy novel | Antonio López Sánchez
palabras.seo_desc: Two civilizations pursue Master Astrom to Earth. Excerpts of an unpublished fantasy novel, a prequel to El otro lado del espejo, by Antonio López Sánchez.
